items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-02
items.q: But there's still old Sister Maggie probably down there.

ctx.x: It's wonderful. Half of them tone up, you know, the places, just like Wiley Avenue, all tone up. Well, that's the way it was really. But there's still old Sister Maggie probably down there. Some of the, the old women that probably was young when I was a child. And they would say, come here, boy. I'll raise you. I'd say, okay. I haven't met parents when I was a little kid.
If you had your choice of places to perform, where have you been best received? Where would you like to go?
